sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach remain top with 22 points from 10 games despite that defeat, and host an Alsager side struggling at the foot of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: The rest of Saturday's action sees several fixtures with potential title-race implications. Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in what could be a chance to close the gap on leaders Sandbach if results go their way. AFC Bridgnorth, third with 19 points, host Eccleshall at home looking to build on recent wins, while Wolverhampton Casuals—also on 19 points—visit Wednesfield Community. Bilston Town, sitting sixth and in-form with three consecutive wins, take on Foley Meir. Mid-table clashes include Market Drayton Town hosting New Mills, Crewe entertaining Allscott Heath, Cheadle Heath Nomads away at Telford Town, and Shawbury United—on a run of five consecutive losses—hosting Barnton. Brereton Social play at home to Widnes Town (who sit bottom with just 2 points). A midweek fixture sees Brereton Social travel to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October.
